purpose: Development-informed same-case qualification of python-deployment-v2 counterexample timing, shared budget persistence, and post-episode evaluation isolation. This run is not admissible as algorithm-effect or held-out evidence.
qualification_checks: The independent run audit is valid and persisted model usage is nonzero.
Every candidate and fresh environment consumes the shared persisted budget exactly once.
Any second candidate is proposed only after first-candidate internal evidence and normalized constraints are persisted.
Post-episode official evidence is absent from every model request and online state transition.
Malformed, unresolved, or contradictory verifier output fails closed.

reporting.network_retry: Only one separately recorded retry after explicit user confirmation of a local network failure.
